# skills

给各种 AI agent 用的开源技能（Agent Skills，`SKILL.md` 格式）。
Open-source Agent Skills (`SKILL.md` format) that work with any AI agent.

## 怎么用 / How to use

直接对你的 agent 说：

> 帮我安装 https://github.com/windgeek/skills 里的 **voice-clone** 这个 skill。

Just tell your agent:

> Install the **voice-clone** skill from https://github.com/windgeek/skills for me.

装好后，用一句话告诉它你要做什么，比如“用我的声音给这段文案配音”。它会先说明需要下载什么、再征求你的同意。
Then just say what you want, e.g. "narrate this script in my voice". The agent explains what needs downloading and asks before doing it.

## voice-clone

在 Mac 本地复刻**你自己的声音**，生成中文（及中英混合）配音；全部在本机运行，音频不上传。
Clones your own voice locally (Apple Silicon Mac, CosyVoice3). Everything runs on your machine; no audio is uploaded.

- 仓库不含任何模型；首次使用时会在你同意后下载约 10 GB（代码、模型、依赖）。Nothing is bundled; ~10 GB is downloaded on first use, after your consent.
- 配完自动“听写自查”：用 macOS 26 自带的离线语音识别把每句配音转成文字，和台词按拼音比对，标出可能读错、漏字的句子，缩小你需要重点试听的范围。After generation, an offline listen-back check (macOS 26 speech recognition) compares each line with the script by pinyin and flags likely misreadings or dropped words for you to re-listen.
- 只复刻本人或已获明确授权的声音；发布时按平台和当地法规标注“AI 生成内容”。Only clone your own voice, or one you have explicit permission to use, and label published audio as AI-generated.

## code-cinema

用代码（Canvas / WebGL + 无头浏览器 + ffmpeg）给歌或故事做有艺术性的 MV 和短片，不用视频生成模型。
Makes artistic music videos and short films in code, without video-generation models.

**它会进化。** 每次做片子，它先分析歌的内容，再按“媒介即内容”为这首歌**原创一个画面风格**，写成风格规格存进风格库；已有风格只在真的贴合时才复用，连续两支片子不会用同一个风格。所以你用得越多，风格库越丰富，自带的 4 个风格只是起点。
**It evolves.** For every film it analyses the song, then invents a fitting visual style ("the medium is the content") and saves it to a growing style library. Existing styles are reused only when they truly fit, and two films in a row never share a style. The 4 bundled styles are just a starting point.

**交付前自动审片。** 自带框景检查（`framecheck.mjs`）：硬切处画面是否落在拍点上、不在拍点上的闪烁、叠字、字出画、长时间静止、并行渲染是否逐帧一致，问题帧会标出红框拼成一张图。
**Automatic pre-delivery check.** `framecheck.mjs` flags cuts whose visual change misses the beat, stray flicker frames, overlapping or clipped text, long static stretches and non-deterministic frames, and outputs a contact sheet with the problem areas boxed in red.

需要：macOS（Apple 芯片）、Chrome、ffmpeg、Node.js、Python 3。Requires: Apple-silicon macOS, Chrome, ffmpeg, Node.js, Python 3.

## skill-refine

skill 越用越长：每次踩坑、每次被纠正，都往里加一条。只往后追加，几轮之后同一条规则写了三遍，新规则和旧规则互相打架，真正要紧的硬规则埋在一堆案例里。这个 skill 让 agent 在**每次改完 skill 后**做一遍精炼：通读全部内容，把新规则归到对的主题下，合并重复，按你最新的意思统一冲突，把案例挪进 references/、让 SKILL.md 保持精简，并且不弱化你说过的任何一条要求，最后报告改了什么。
Skills grow by appending lessons, and soon the same rule appears three times, new rules contradict old ones, and the hard rules get buried. After every skill edit, this skill has the agent read everything, file the new rule under the right topic, merge duplicates, resolve contradictions in favour of your latest intent, keep SKILL.md lean, never water down a requirement, and report what changed.

- `lint_skill.py`（只读）：查结构（frontmatter、篇幅、断链、没人引用的文件）、重复条目（跨文件、跨 skill）、冲突线索（同一话题不同数值、“必须 / 不要”相反）、按时间堆积的迹象。Read-only linter for structure, duplicates across files and skills, contradiction hints, and append-only sprawl.
- `remind_hook.py`（可选）：Claude Code 的 PostToolUse 钩子，写入 skill 目录后提醒 agent 精炼，每个 skill 每个会话只提醒一次；安装前需要你同意。Optional Claude Code hook that reminds the agent once per skill per session; installed only with your consent.

需要：Python 3。Requires: Python 3.

## novel

长篇网文写到几十章以后，最常见的事故是忘事：人物知道了不该知道的事、约好的见面没下文、地名前后不一、伏笔埋了没收。这个 skill 让 agent 把小说当成一个项目来写：设定、大纲、人物、连贯性日志、伏笔表都存在 `novel/` 目录里，每写一章前按需加载，写完后逐项校验并更新。之后你只要说“继续”，它会自己恢复进度、判断要不要先做一致性检查或补大纲，然后写下一章。
Long serials break down after a few dozen chapters: characters know things they shouldn't, promised meetings never happen, place names drift, foreshadowing is never paid off. This skill has the agent run the novel as a project: setting, outlines, characters, a continuity log and a foreshadowing tracker live in `novel/`, loaded in tiers before each chapter and checked and updated after it. Then you just say "continue": it restores state, decides whether a consistency check or a new outline is due, and writes the next chapter.

- 章节字数、标题、正文排版按番茄小说的平台限制设定；用在别的平台时改一下即可。Chapter length, title and formatting rules follow Fanqie Novel's limits; adjust them for other platforms.
- 每 10 章自动做一次一致性检查，日志和伏笔表按卷归档，长篇写到几百章也不会撑爆上下文。A consistency audit every 10 chapters and per-volume archiving keep the working files small even after hundreds of chapters.

需要：能读写本地文件的 agent。Requires: an agent that can read and write local files.

## apple-app-localization

给 macOS / iOS 等苹果平台 app 做国际化和翻译：把旧的 `.strings` 迁移到 String Catalog，补上复数，用生成的符号让拼错的 key 变成编译错误；翻译时系统名词（访达、废纸篓、快速查看……）一律从 macOS 自己的资源里查，不靠猜；起草和复核分两遍做，最后做多语言运行时验收。以后每次功能改动新增文案，它也会自动把各语言补齐。
Internationalizes and translates Apple-platform apps: migrates legacy `.strings` to String Catalogs, adds plurals, and uses generated symbols so a misspelt key fails to compile. OS terms are looked up from macOS's own resources, never guessed; drafting and review are separate passes, followed by runtime checks per locale. Later feature work that adds strings gets every language filled in too.

需要：macOS、Xcode 26 以上、Python 3。Requires: macOS, Xcode 26+, Python 3.

## ship-macos-apps

让 AI 编程 agent 参与 macOS app 开发时，最容易出事的是“身份”：Debug 和正式版共用 bundle ID、agent 从命令行启动了正式版，结果隐私权限、菜单栏图标在开发机上错乱，别人的机器却正常。这个 skill 把开发、本地 Release、TestFlight、上架分成四条互不污染的线，并附只读的项目和已安装 app 体检脚本、发布前检查清单。
When an AI coding agent helps build a macOS app, the usual failures are about identity: Debug and Release share a bundle ID, or the agent launches the production build from a shell, and permissions or the menu bar icon break on the developer's Mac only. This skill keeps development, local Release, TestFlight and App Store as four separate lanes, with read-only project / installed-app audits and release gates.

需要：macOS、Xcode。Requires: macOS, Xcode.

## suno-music-producer

用 Suno 写歌：从一句话、一个律动或一个场景发展出完整的歌，直接给出可粘贴的 Title、Styles、参数和 Lyrics；中文歌词会逐句检查唱读时的重音、倒字和换气。
Writes songs for Suno, growing a full song from one line, groove or scene, and outputs ready-to-paste Title, Styles, parameters and Lyrics; Chinese lyrics are checked line by line for stress, tone inversion and breathing.

需要：Suno 账号。Requires: a Suno account.

## wechat-article

写读者愿意读完的公众号文章：动笔前先写选题卡（读者、张力、主张、回报、证据），给每个承重结论找到原始来源，再按结构、段落、句子三层删稿，最后过十项发布前质量门；科普稿另有一套“谜题—机制—迁移”的写法。输出两份 Markdown 母稿。
Writes WeChat Official Account articles people finish: a topic card first (reader, tension, claim, payoff, evidence), primary sources for every load-bearing claim, cutting at structure / paragraph / sentence level, and ten pre-publish gates; popular-science pieces get a puzzle → mechanism → transfer method. Outputs two Markdown masters.

- 排版交给第三方的 [gzh-design](https://github.com/isjiamu/gzh-design-skill)（需另行安装）。Layout is handed to the third-party gzh-design skill, installed separately.
- 推送到草稿箱是可选的，需要你自己在 `.env` 里填公众号的 AppID 和 AppSecret，而且每次都要你明确说“发布”才会执行。Uploading to the drafts box is optional, needs your own AppID/AppSecret in `.env`, and only runs when you explicitly ask.

需要：Python 3。Requires: Python 3.
